id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

content.description: The displayed content of the button.

link.description: The link to direct to if the usage style is a link.

usage.description: The the usage style for the button.

orientation.description: The orientation to display avatar and text with, either vertical or horizontal. Defaults to horizontal.

truncate.description: Whether the text should be truncated

truncatedCharacterLimit.description:
If provided, the inner text content will be truncated to this character limit. Only applicable when the truncate prop is true.
Useful to prevent rendering extremely long strings onto the DOM even when truncation is enabled.

tooltip.description: Renders a tooltip when hover over content

opensInNewTab.description: Whether link should open in new tab if the usage style is a link.

title: An optionally clickable component supporting avatar & text
name: ClickableAvatarWithTextComponent
